_about: How heavy common ingredients are, so cups and spoons can be converted to grams (Metric view) and grams to cups (US view). gPerMl = grams per millilitre (1 Australian cup = 250 ml, so 0.6 = 150 g per cup). gPerMlSifted = the lighter weight used when an ingredient line says sifted: true. liquid = shown in ml, not grams. Names must match the ingredient's 'item' exactly (lowercase). A recipe can also give its own value with gPerMl on the ingredient line. Values are approximate: the weight of a cup depends on how it's filled. Flour: 150 g per cup is the Australian Women's Weekly standard (unsifted); sifted or spooned flour is lighter, about 125 g. Weighing your own cup once and recording it here is always best.
